recurringPatterns.pattern: 'establishes X / does not establish Y' antithesis as the default paragraph engine, dozens of times per chapter
instances: Jebel Sahaba establishes a concentration of violent injury...; it cannot establish a general rate...
Its presence establishes investment in controlled space. It does not identify an enemy, a battle, or the frequency of attack.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Chapters end with a one-paragraph thesis restatement on the same three-clause balanced cadence, fifteen times
instances: Steppe power became durable only when movement was converted into provisioning, siege, taxation, and allegiance, while settled states endured...
The scale of aggression changed through those arrangements, not through the appearance of a weapon acting by itself.

recurringPatterns.pattern: The 'chain' metaphor imported into every period as the explanatory device
instances: The practical chain ran from stores to officials, officials to labour, labour to walls and campaigns...
The railway carried the recruit, the factory produced the shell, the census office identified the body...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Symmetrical 'restrained one violence while enlarging another' hedge as the settled verdict on every institution
instances: Assyrian expansion created a political order that restrained some violence by organizing larger forms of coercion.
Law created regularity, and regularity could serve restraint and domination at once.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Uniform paragraph architecture plus orphaned one-line paragraphs that read as errors
instances: The stones cannot assign each worker one motive.
Safety was distributed through political membership.

summary: Serious survey, real thesis; near-total absence of narrative energy; visible compositional debris: a chapter opening quoting another chapter's opening sentence, cross-references to 'Chapter 12' and 'chapter 14' inside the prose, orphaned one-line paragraphs, Talheim/Guernica/Wannsee recycled across chapters.
